title: Tony Hsu
text: I am a fish ecologist at the University of Sydney with a strong interest in behaviour, interaction, and ecological functions in primarily but not limited to coral reef ecosystems. I used multiple tools including fish surveys (visual census, video-based techniques, and eDNA), benthic surveys (photogrammetry and photo-transect), and lab-based approaches (stable isotopes, fatty acids, and other organismal traits) to answer my research questions. With my PhD thesis recently submitted, I am actively seeking postdoctoral, academic, or research-intensive roles where I can apply my skills. I am always open to discussing new collaborations or opportunities. Please feel free to connect or contact me directly at tony.tsaihsuan.hsu@gmail.com.
